notes.title: Hotfix 1.3
notes.notes:
Corrected two coordinates in level 26 of the Geometric campaign. The level is now solvable. Sorry for the inconvenience.

[i]Note:
If you are currently on this level make sure to restart it from the campaign window and not load it from the save game option.
[/i]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that caused already unlocked campaign levels to get locked again if an earlier level was replayed and solved.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1
notes.notes: Level 46 of the Vanilla campaign was replaced with a less irritating level structure.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0
notes.notes: The default background music volume was increased by a notch since it was barely audible before, in comparison to the sound effects, even when on the highest setting.

notes.title: Technical Issue with Release
notes.notes: Unfortunately there seems to be a technical issue with the release of the game. I have already released it but the release did not carry through to the store yet. I am waiting for this to be resolved. I'm very sorry for the wait. I hope this will be resolved quickly so you can all enjoy some relaxed puzzling during the weekend!

notes.title: Release
notes.notes:
The game is available now. Enjoy untangling!
Thank you to everyone that supported me in polishing the game during the past weeks by giving suggestions and reporting bugs. I hope everyone enjoys the game. 

If you find any bugs or have suggestions, feel free to join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/NNvjJM5mmq]official Discord[/url] or submit them through the other available channels (Steam, E-Mail, etc.). I will try to answer any questions and attend to any issues as quickly as possible.

Have a cozy weekend!
